output.recommendation: Confirm where new users struggle before expanding the rollout.
output.rationale: Three interviewees missed the first useful action. Five existing customers are too small a sample to estimate conversion.
output.uncertainty: There are no results from first-time users or measured pilot outcomes.

output.recommendation: Prepare a small pilot around a clearer first action and fewer required fields.
output.rationale: A narrow experience gives the team a way to test the handoff finding with first-time users.
output.uncertainty: The research does not tell us which field changes will help most.

output.recommendation: Hold distribution until the mobile and accessibility checks pass.
output.rationale: The release brief requires the mobile review and quality checklist. The sample gives us no passing results.
output.uncertainty: The board and brief do not establish whether blockers have been fixed.

humanDecision.reason: Check mobile and keyboard quality before distributing the pilot.

output.nextStep: Run the mobile and keyboard checks, record blockers on the board and bring the results back to the project lead.
